hooks.text: 把卡努杜斯战争改写成拯救导师灵魂的巴西黑暗奇幻
hooks.excerpt: In the 19th century, Canudos became a refuge for thousands. When its people defied the new Republic, they faced brutal retaliation, leaving 25,000 dead. Play as Pajeú, a warrior fighting to rescue the soul of The Counselor, his fallen mentor.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可移除倒计时沉浸叙事，也可用Hardcore挑战历史压迫者
hooks.excerpt: Whether you seek a brutal test against history's oppressors or a thoughtful journey of justice, Hell Clock adapts to your path. Remove all time pressure with Relaxed Mode, or push your limits in Hardcore mode.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 遗物既能镶嵌工具强化，也可腐化赌祝福或灾厄
hooks.excerpt: Take your builds to the next level by Imbuing Relics with Tools to increase their power and add new effects. Or take the risk for greater rewards by Corrupting your Relics, with equal chances for blessing or bane.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
